batch: NTCore Vista4Experts and AntiMida current source and exact-artifact acquisition
decision: Both publisher-listed products remain selected for migration preparation under the 2026-10-27 NTCore collection decision. No license disposition is being used as a migration gate.

sourceFindings: Publisher describes a Windows Vista configuration utility that changes UAC, automatic Windows Defender scanning, automatic updates and other settings.
Publisher claims changes can be enabled, discarded or reversed, but the current page does not map individual effects or prior-state restoration.
vista4experts.migrationDisposition: Keep selected. The old Vista focus and broad settings behavior do not establish Windows 11 package support or a RIDE setting mapping.

publisherSourceFindings: Article describes a research helper for working with Themida-protected processes; capabilities include process memory inspection/dumping and file/registry access monitoring.
The described design injects a user-mode DLL into a selected process and uses a companion kernel driver for protected process-memory operations.
Publisher warns that the techniques are obsolete and that the project does not work with PAE.
antimida.migrationDisposition: Keep selected for package preparation under the full collection decision. Treat compatibility, installed scope and driver behavior as technical acceptance questions; do not infer Windows support from the article.

retrieval.webReader: The official download links were identified, but both ZIP retrievals failed because the reader does not support application/zip content.

directPublisherRequests.Vista4Experts.zip: Failed before response: No such host is known (ntcore.com:443).
directPublisherRequests.antimida_1.0.zip: Failed before response: No such host is known (ntcore.com:443).

resolved: Current publisher page/version and described product capabilities were rechecked.
deferred: Acquire exact publisher ZIP bytes, record SHA-256, and statically inventory package members before adding pinned candidates.
Establish candidate install scope and Windows target support separately through authorized acceptance.
partial: Both products remain selected but lack hash-pinned catalog candidates.

estimate.adjustment: None. This source and acquisition batch closes no legacy outcome; unavailable exact archives prevent candidate completion.
